ctx.x: No. That was a long trip then. No. It wasn't possible. We were too poor for one thing. From the time I was twelve years old I guess I worked all the time. My family hadn't lost everything that they own. I bought my own clothes all the time and worked and went to school.
Did you know Curly Lozano over on the golf course? Oh yes sir.

Where was he from? I can't say. But he was over there. Yeah. You know the Karuba family, Mike and all, you know Mike. I know Mike, yes. Well I, well there was a family of Karubas that lived in Long Beach and I think Mike must be part of that family. Mm-hmm. I couldn't say. And I played a job with Mike not too long ago with Val Barbaro.
